title: The Five Fathers in Successive Emanation
description: The culminating foundation: the Lord recognized at five registers as he goes forth toward the soul, each called from the one before. The first is divine love itself — immeasurable, glorious, the only-begotten before everything that has come to be. From him proceed three: life-bearing principle, recognized-and-returned love, accommodated call. The second register is that very call — divine truth going out as accommodated revelation. The third is divine truth shining forth as illumining wisdom. The fourth is the Lord ordering the rational from within. The fifth is the inner image taking form as living vessel. Five Fathers, but one Lord unfolded in five degrees — the inmost accommodating itself downward until it can meet the soul where the soul is.
